suite: Suite PR #565 (Fiscal Regime Designer Full precision switch and total tax per regime, stacked on #554)

intermediate.append: Read the figures in the Fiscal Regime Designer with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping. Its Summary tab then shows the total tax for each regime.
intermediate.why: The Designer printed no total tax per regime.
